body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education (KITE), the technology wing of the Kerala General Education Department, has now distributed 29,000 robotic kits to high schools across Kerala, introducing students to emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The official announcement regarding this will be made by V. Sivankutty, Minister for General Education at the Little KITEs state camp on February 8 at the ICFOSS campus, here. On the day, an exhibition of student-created robotic projects will also be staged.
